meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用约束模型计算代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除带来的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用约束模型研究代谢网络、做通量或基因敲除分析。
copy.tagline_en: Model metabolic networks to compute fluxes and predict gene knockout effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study metabolic networks with constraint-based models.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Python 的 COBRApy 库加载基因组尺度代谢模型(SBML/JSON/YAML),运行 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样等模拟,并输出通量数值、必需基因表或培养基配方。
howto.when: 当你要加载、构建或导出代谢模型,运行 FBA/FVA 等通量分析,或做基因、反应敲除筛选时触发。

say.text: 用 textbook 模型跑 FBA,告诉我最大生长速率
say.note: 返回目标值和各反应通量

say.text: 对 e_coli_core 做单基因敲除,列出必需基因
say.note: 输出敲除后的生长结果表

say.text: 算这个模型在 50% 最大生长下的最小培养基
say.note: 给出培养基成分与用量

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude loads genome-scale metabolic models (SBML/JSON/YAML) with the Python COBRApy library, runs FBA, FVA, knockouts and flux sampling, and reports flux values, essential genes or media recipes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you load, build or export metabolic models, run FBA/FVA flux analyses, or screen gene or reaction knockouts; also used for media design and gap-filling.

say_en.text: Run FBA on the textbook model and tell me the max growth rate
Do a single gene deletion on e_coli_core and list essential genes
Compute the minimal medium for 50% of max growth on this model
